questions.text: What event uses up one free query?
options: Only a query that ends with a completed action plan
Only a query that would otherwise be charged
questions.reason: The decision says to show the remaining balance but not what reduces it; the blueprint suggests charging only on completion.

questions.text: Should existing users (created before this feature ships) also start with two free queries?
questions.reason: The decision only mentions new users; existing accounts need a defined starting balance.

questions.text: Do queries a person made as a guest (before signing in) count against their free queries?
options: No, the count starts at sign-up
Yes, guest queries are carried over when they sign in
questions.reason: The blueprint allows guest-first access, but the decision covers only signed-in users.

questions.text: Besides the remaining count, what should the API response include?
questions.reason: This decides the response shape; the decision only names the remaining count.

questions.text: Is the starting allowance of 2 fixed, or should it be stored as a configurable value?
options: Configurable value (no admin UI in this requirement)
questions.reason: The blueprint lists admin-managed free-query allowances as a separate feature; this decides whether to plan for it now.
